WITH user_borrow_data AS ( SELECT bb.user_id, bb.borrow_id, bb.borrow_time, bb.expected_return_time, bb.actual_return_time, bb.borrow_status, -- 计算每本书的阅读天数 CASE WHEN bb.actual_return_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, bb.borrow_time, bb.actual_return_time) WHEN bb.actual_return_time IS NULL AND CURDATE() > bb.expected_return_time THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, bb.borrow_time, bb.expected_return_time) ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, bb.borrow_time, CURDATE()) END as reading_days FROM book_borrow bb WHERE bb.user_id = #{userId} AND bb.borrow_status IN (0, 1, 2, 3) ) SELECT -- 本月借阅数量 COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(borrow_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as month_borrow_count,
-- 累计借阅数量 COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT borrow_id), 0) as total_borrow_count,
-- 借阅频率（本/月） CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, MIN(borrow_time), CURDATE()) = 0 THEN COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT borrow_id), 0) ELSE COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT borrow_id) / TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, MIN(borrow_time), CURDATE()), 0) END as borrow_frequency,
-- 平均阅读时长（天/本） CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT borrow_id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(AVG(reading_days), 0) END as average_reading_days FROM user_borrow_data
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT borrow_id) FROM book_borrow WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND borrow_status IN (0, 1, 2, 3) AND DATE_FORMAT(borrow_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT borrow_id) FROM book_borrow WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND borrow_status IN (0, 1, 2, 3)

SELECT CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, MIN(borrow_time), CURDATE()) = 0 THEN COUNT(DISTINCT borrow_id) ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT borrow_id) / TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, MIN(borrow_time), CURDATE()) END as borrow_frequency FROM book_borrow WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND borrow_status IN (0, 1, 2, 3)

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT borrow_id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE AVG( CASE WHEN actual_return_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, borrow_time, actual_return_time) WHEN actual_return_time IS NULL AND CURDATE() > expected_return_time THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, borrow_time, expected_return_time) ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, borrow_time, CURDATE()) END ) END as average_reading_days FROM book_borrow WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND borrow_status IN (0, 1, 2, 3)

WITH user_category_borrow AS ( SELECT bc.category_id, bc.category_code, bc.category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT bb.borrow_id) as borrow_count FROM book_borrow bb INNER JOIN book_info bi ON bb.book_id = bi.book_id INNER JOIN book_category bc ON bi.category_id = bc.category_id WHERE bb.user_id = #{userId} AND bb.borrow_status IN (0, 1, 2, 3) GROUP BY bc.category_id, bc.category_code, bc.category_name ), total_borrow AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT borrow_id) as total_count FROM book_borrow WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND borrow_status IN (0, 1, 2, 3) ), top_categories AS ( SELECT ucb.*, ROUND(ucb.borrow_count * 100.0 / tb.total_count, 2) as percentage FROM user_category_borrow ucb CROSS JOIN total_borrow tb ORDER BY ucb.borrow_count DESC LIMIT 5 ), other_categories AS ( SELECT '其他' as category_code, '其他' as category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT bb.borrow_id) as borrow_count, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT bb.borrow_id) * 100.0 / tb.total_count, 2) as percentage FROM book_borrow bb INNER JOIN book_info bi ON bb.book_id = bi.book_id INNER JOIN book_category bc ON bi.category_id = bc.category_id CROSS JOIN total_borrow tb WHERE bb.user_id = #{userId} AND bb.borrow_status IN (0, 1, 2, 3) AND bc.category_id NOT IN (SELECT category_id FROM top_categories) GROUP BY tb.total_count ) -- 合并前五类别和其他类别 SELECT NULL as category_id, category_code, category_name, borrow_count, percentage FROM top_categories
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL as category_id, category_code, category_name, borrow_count, percentage FROM other_categories WHERE borrow_count > 0
